name: Networks
author: Menno van Leeuwen
description: Wi-Fi, wired, DNS and every VPN (Mullvad, NetBird, Tailscale, WireGuard, OpenVPN) in one Omarchy bar panel, with several VPNs connected at once.

barWidget.description: Every VPN tunnel in one list. Each toggles on its own, so split-tunnel VPNs can run side by side.
